sections.heading: What is trending: “games”
paragraphs: “games” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for US (snapshot taken 2026-08-13T17:11:35+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-13T17:11:35+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-13T17:12:57+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from PlayStation.Blog, The Verge, Variety. The associated headlines are: “Hands-on report: Marvel’s Wolverine” (PlayStation.Blog); “Watch Out, Spider-Man: ‘Marvel’s Wolverine’ Game Could Be the Best Superhero Story of the Year” (Variety); “Wolverine on the PS5 made me care about Marvel’s mutant for the first time” (The Verge).
Google reports at least 2,000 searches in US as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers US. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
